request.neutral_instruction: Solve the supplied programming task. Return only the requested artifact. Do not call tools.
request.prompt:
Produce a correct x86-64 implementation of this task.
Given unsigned 64-bit integers x and y, return their greatest common divisor. gcd(0,0)=0, gcd(x,0)=x, gcd(0,y)=y. The whole unsigned 64-bit range is allowed. Example: x=48, y=18 returns 6.
No tools, execution, compiler, assembler, external lookup, or testing. Work out the answer yourself. One final artifact only.
Interface: System V AMD64 leaf function. x is in RDI, y in RSI; return the unsigned 64-bit answer in RAX using RET. Preserve RBX, RBP and R12-R15 if used. Function starts at address 0x100000. No syscalls, external calls, absolute addresses, or data outside its code and ordinary stack. Use baseline integer x86-64 instructions.
Return only Intel-syntax assembly accepted by Keystone x86-64, at most 100 lines. Labels are allowed. No directives, fences, comments, explanations or placeholders. An external assembler will encode this control condition.

text:
mov rax, rdi
test rsi, rsi
jz done
gcd_loop:
xor edx, edx
div rsi
mov rax, rsi
mov rsi, rdx
test rsi, rsi
jnz gcd_loop
done:
ret
